defects.description: The cursor is created_at alone and the next page filters strictly after it, so rows sharing the boundary timestamp are skipped and never returned.
defects.why_missed: Every suite row has a distinct timestamp, so the strict comparison is correct on that data; the loss only appears when a page boundary falls inside a group of equal timestamps.
defects.severity_rationale: A supported page with tied timestamps silently omits records a caller relies on.

detection_criteria.mechanism: The cursor is created_at alone and the next page filters strictly after it, so rows sharing the boundary timestamp are skipped and never returned.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
